---
title: "Install"
---

Python 3.10 or newer, [Poppler](https://poppler.freedesktop.org/) (`pdftoppm`) and [Tesseract OCR](https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tesseract) (`tesseract`).

```bash
git clone https://github.com/tungufoss/lowpoly-pdf-to-svg.git
cd lowpoly-pdf-to-svg
make install         # python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
```

If Poppler is not on `PATH`, pass `--pdftoppm C:\path\to\pdftoppm.exe` to the converter.

## For this site

The results pages are built with [Quarto](https://quarto.org/) and R (tidyverse, xml2, DT):

```bash
make report          # render report/_site
make preview         # serve on localhost, re-render on save
```

The public site on GitHub Pages is rebuilt on every push to `main` from the files committed in `data/bowser/` (edge table, fold-up glue table, status page) and the benchmark results in `bench/`. The traced sheets are the creator's pattern (free for personal use), so they appear only in a local build.
